## 1. Build, Lint, Test and Coverage

| Command | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `npm run dev` | `vite dev` — local dev server (localhost:8080) |
| `npm run build` | `vite build` — Nitro build, preset `NITRO_PRESET` or `node-server` → `.output/` |
| `vite build --mode development` | Development-mode build (`build:dev` script) |
| `npm run start` | `node .output/server/index.mjs` — production SSR server, `PORT=3000` |
| `vite preview` | Preview built output (`preview` script) |
| `npm run lint` | `eslint .` |
| `npm run format` | `prettier --write .` |
| `npm run assets:download` | `node scripts/download-assets.mjs` — fetch binaries for `*.asset.json` stubs |

- Tests: none configured.
- Coverage: none configured.
- CI: `.github/workflows/coolify-deploy.yml` only POSTs the Coolify deploy API (push to `main` + `workflow_dispatch`); no build/lint/test in CI. Run `npm run lint` and `npm run build` locally before pushing.

## 2. Code Style & Project Conventions

- Stack: TypeScript ^5.8.3 strict, TanStack Start ^1.168.26 + TanStack Router, React ^19.2.0, Vite ^8, Tailwind CSS ^4.2.1, shadcn/ui new-york.
- Format: Prettier 3, printWidth 100, semicolons, double quotes, trailingComma all (`.prettierrc`, `.prettierignore`).
- Lint: ESLint 9 flat config + typescript-eslint + react-hooks + react-refresh + prettier plugin (`eslint.config.js`).
- Import `server-only` is banned; use `*.server.ts` files or `@tanstack/react-start/server-only` (`eslint.config.js` `no-restricted-imports`).
- `@typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars` is off (`eslint.config.js`).
- Types: strict mode, ES2022, moduleResolution Bundler (`tsconfig.json`).
- Imports: use `@/*` alias for `src/*` (`tsconfig.json`, vite-tsconfig-paths).
- Class names: merge with `cn` from `src/lib/utils.ts`.
- UI primitives live in `src/components/ui/` (shadcn); landing sections live in `src/components/landing/`.
- Routing: TanStack file-based routes in `src/routes/`; only root layout is `src/routes/__root.tsx`; keep `<Outlet />` in it; no `src/pages` or `app/layout.tsx`.
- `src/routeTree.gen.ts` is generated; never edit (`.prettierignore`).
- Assets: import binaries directly, e.g. `import logo from "@/assets/mtr-logo.png"`; never import `.asset.json` stubs in components.
- Favicons derive from `src/assets/mtr-logo.png`: `public/favicon.ico` (multi-res 16–256px), `public/favicon.png` (192px), `public/apple-touch-icon.png` (180px); linked in `src/routes/__root.tsx` head.
- Build target: Nitro `preset: process.env.NITRO_PRESET || "node-server"` in `vite.config.ts`; standalone Node server, not Cloudflare Workers.
- Contact form (`src/components/landing/interactive.tsx`) validates with zod client-side only; no backend submission exists.
- Details: [docs/agents/coding_guidelines.md](docs/agents/coding_guidelines.md).

## 3. Agent Communication & Behavioral Guidelines

- Keep `main` in a working state; every push syncs to Lovable and triggers a Coolify deploy.
- Run `npm run lint` and `npm run build` before committing; CI does not.
- Ask the user before adding `minimumReleaseAgeExcludes` entries to `bunfig.toml`.

### Never in this repository

- Never force push or rebase/amend/squash already-pushed commits (Lovable history sync).
- Never edit `src/routeTree.gen.ts`.
- Never revert components to `.asset.json` imports.
- Never re-add plugins bundled by `@lovable.dev/vite-tanstack-config` (tanstackStart, viteReact, tailwind, tsConfigPaths, nitro, devtools) in `vite.config.ts`.
- Never import `server-only` (`eslint.config.js`).

## 4. Setup, Troubleshooting and Tips

Prereqs: Node.js 22, npm (`package-lock.json`). `bun.lock` + `bunfig.toml` also committed.

```sh
npm install
npm run dev
npm run assets:download
```

Docker (multi-stage `node:22-alpine`, `NITRO_PRESET=node-server`, port 3000):

```sh
docker build -t lp-myteamrenovation .
docker run -p 3000:3000 lp-myteamrenovation
```

Deploy: push to `main` → `.github/workflows/coolify-deploy.yml` POSTs Coolify (`aguiardev.online`) with secret `COOLIFY_API_TOKEN` as Bearer header; Coolify rebuilds the Docker image.

| Symptom | Check |
|---|---|
| New `*.asset.json` stubs pulled from Lovable, images missing | Run `npm run assets:download` |
| Build targets Cloudflare Workers / wrong output | Check `NITRO_PRESET`; default is `node-server` |
| SSR 500 shows HTML error page | Inspect `src/server.ts` and `src/lib/error-capture.ts` |
| Duplicate Vite plugin errors | Remove manually added plugins from `vite.config.ts` |

Env vars: `NITRO_PRESET` (build), `NODE_ENV`/`HOST`/`PORT` (Dockerfile), `COOLIFY_API_TOKEN` (GitHub secret). No `.env.example`.
